context: Year-end recap of the museum’s program
purpose: Recap the year; teach 国立/千葉/２月/１２月/８月/１０月/男女/３つ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 国立美術館の年間プログラム、終わりました。
lines.en: The national museum’s yearly program wrapped up.
lines.style: satisfied planner reflecting, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 千葉まで何度も足を運びました。
lines.en: I went to Chiba many times.
lines.style: devoted visitor sharing, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ２月から１２月まで、無事に開催できました。
lines.en: From February through December, we held it without incident.
lines.style: planner relieved and proud, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ８月の夏祭りコラボも素敵でした。
lines.en: August’s summer-festival collab was lovely too.
lines.style: visitor recalling fondly, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: １０月の市民参加型企画も大盛況でした。
lines.en: October’s citizen-participation event was a big hit.
lines.style: planner crediting success, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 男女・世代を超えて集まる場でしたね。
lines.en: It was a place where genders and generations met.
lines.style: visitor appreciating, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ３つのテーマで、来年も継続します。
lines.en: We’ll continue with the three themes next year too.
lines.style: planner committing forward, tone holding steady through the whole line
